notes: Score: +1000 if the arrangement cannot carry the pods' push (EXO_PODS 100 %) or a tow by the boat's engine (BOAT_ENGINE 100 %) without the boat sliding into the EXO structure (an equilibrium reached only with INTERFERENCE counts as 'cannot'), +1 per kN of the highest line tension under push and under tow, +3 per line slack at rest, +1 per line that goes slack in the reference wave, +100 if the hull would touch a float in the reference wave (else +5 per 0.1 m of clearance below 0.1 m), +2 if the boat slides more than 80 mm under push or tow. Attachment points are ASSUMED post and cleat positions.

A line can only pull: to push the boat forward a line must run from an EXO point to a boat point AFT of it; to tow (or brake) the boat it must run to a boat point FORWARD of it. Both are needed for a thrust-capable berth; long lines carry force with less lateral squeeze than short cross lines.
